method.principle: Philipp's ruling: 'real legible text is LEGAL by construction — only GENERATED text can forge.' The two G6-failing generative hero shots (S2 shoes, S4 belt) are replaced by DETERMINISTIC camera-moves over the REAL certified digitisations, showing the athletes' ACTUAL ink/signature. Zero fabrication possible (real pixels only) — the certificate pipeline (same as the medals + build_first_flame).
method.S2_insert: slow push over raw SM_RV_18_white_shoes_tokyo.png (Tentoglou's real shoes), 2.875s/69f, Bruised-Gold vignette grade + grain. Shows the REAL '8.41 / Miltos Tentoglou / TOKYO 2020' ink — authentic, correctly spelled.
method.S4_insert: slow pan along raw SM_RV_22_Belt.png (Iliadis's real belt), 3.166667s/76f, same grade. Shows the REAL signature + figure-8 stitching + buckle.
method.splice: ffmpeg concat: v2[0:3.125](S1) + S2 insert + v2[6.0:8.5417](S3) + S4 insert + v2[11.7083:30.0417](S5-S10). Result: exactly 30.041667s / 721 frames, cut boundaries preserved. The other 8 Seedance shots unchanged from the v2 take.

credits.note: deterministic ffmpeg — zero generation, zero credits, per the ruling

G6_forged_text.note: The two hero text-bearing shots now show the athletes' REAL, authentic inscriptions via deterministic insert — legal by construction, fabrication impossible. v2's forgeries ('Mizos', fake signature) are eliminated. RESIDUAL (honest): the KEPT generative S3 lacing shot (outside the S2/S4 ruling scope) retains a minor generative '8.4' trace on the shoe quarter; it is small and hands-dominated. If it matters, S3 too can go deterministic or tight-macro — but the ruling scoped only S2/S4.

kotinos_S9_S10.note: unchanged from v2 — dried golden-brown, open ring, cloth-bound join hold.

clubs_S6_S7 / S8_heels / S1_breath / S5-.note: the 8 kept Seedance shots were already clean in v2 QC.

grade_continuity.note: the deterministic inserts (museum-lit white shoe / cream belt) run WARMER and BRIGHTER than the near-black single-shaft Seedance shots; bridged with a Bruised-Gold vignette + grain so they read as lit-artifact inserts rather than a grade error. A hard cut between a dark performance shot and a lit artifact insert is a valid editorial beat. If a tighter match is wanted, the inserts can be darkened further (at some cost to text legibility).

verdict.status: PASS (USE THIS) — the hero-text forgery is FIXED. Real, authentic athlete inscriptions shown deterministically; zero fabrication; 30s; 0cr. Minor residual generative trace in the kept S3, disclosed.
verdict.measurement_basis: Deterministic (ffprobe exact 721f + the inserts are literal crops of the certified digitisations = fabrication-impossible) + by-eye confirmation the inserts show the REAL correctly-spelled text and the splice seams are clean.

the_lesson: For a TEXT-BEARING artifact at HERO scale, the fix is NOT to hide the text (localised-defocus + recomposition failed — v2) but to SHOW THE REAL TEXT deterministically. Real legible text is legal; only generated text forges. This is the certificate pipeline (deterministic ffmpeg over the certified still), the same solution the medals reached. Generative for everything text-free; deterministic for the text-bearing hero.
